[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Traveler's Vale | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=099 }} [[Traveler's Vale]] is most frequently traversed path in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] as one attempts to cross the mountainous [[region]]. It is currently patrolled by the [[Stone Summit]] who are eager to drive off all non-[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] from the mountain. == Getting there == You can access the area via * [[Yak's Bend]], where you're teleported upon completion of the [[Nolani Academy]] mission * [[Ascalon Foothills]] if running from Ascalon * [[Iron Horse Mine]] if running from Kryta [[The Way is Blocked]] is the [[primary quest]]
